messages:
emma: Hey team — noticed an issue: ATS CSV export is dropping candidate accessibility tags (e.g., requires_live_caption, sign_language). We had a candidate flagged this morning and the interviewer kit didn't show it, which blocked scheduling. cc @sam @jules
sam: Ugh. Which column is disappearing?
jules: Is this the old export pipeline or the new mapping lambda we shipped last week?
emma: Looks like the mapping lambda. The CSV used to have a column `accessibility_flags`. Now the header is there but it's blank for flagged candidates. Example snippet:
```
candidate_id,full_name,accessibility_flags
12345,Alex Doe,requires_live_caption;low_vision
```
Now we get ``candidate_id,full_name,accessibility_flags
12345,Alex Doe,
```
alina: That explains why interviewer_kits didn't render the accommodations notice. Could also affect scorecard UI which surfaces those flags during interview.
sam: Can you paste the raw JSON payload from the ATS webhook for that candidate so eng can see if the source lost the tag before mapping?
emma: Pasted into the thread (redacted PHI):
```
{"id":"12345","name":"Alex Doe","metadata":{"accessibility":[{"type":"live_caption","value":true}]}}
```
So source payload looks fine. Mapping lambda is stripping arrays.
jules: Thanks. I'll take this — probable bug in the array handling after the refactor that flattened metadata. I'll open a small patch. Can we add a quick unit test that covers arrays -> semicolon-joined strings?
emma: Yes please. Also, can we push a manual workaround to ensure current interviews are flagged? I can manually update the interviewer_kits DB but would prefer a short-term script.
jules: I'll add a one-off sync that reads raw webhook payloads and backfills `accessibility_flags` in interviewer_kits. ETA 60–90m. Will post the run log here.
mike-bot: NOTE: job interviewer-kit-backfill queued by jules — job-id bc-20240321-42
sam: After fix, we should: 1) add a check in the ATS export E2E test, 2) add a monitoring alert if any flagged candidate loses flags during mapping. Also add a line in the interviewer training doc about checking the accommodations section before scheduling.
alina: I'll update the interviewer readiness playbook with a quick checklist: "verify accommodations present in kit" + a screenshot. Also can we add a short blurb to the new-hire interviewer slack channel so folks know to double-check for this week?
emma: I'll post the heads-up. Also, small ask — can scorecard templates show an accommodations readonly field so raters remember to adapt? Not urgent but useful.
jules: Agree, adding the readonly field is low-risk. I'll include it in the mapper change and add migration that copies `accessibility_flags` into `scorecard_metadata.accessibility`.
emma: Great. Thanks everyone. Please ping if the backfill job errors.
jules: Backfill started — first batch done (1000 candidates). No errors so far. Will continue.
mike-bot: job bc-20240321-42 status: 1000/6000 processed, 0 errors
sam: Nice. Once job completes, let's run a small audit to verify kits and scorecards for a random sample of 200 flagged candidates. If all good, we can mark incident resolved and post a short postmortem with timeline + root cause.
emma: Sounds good. I'll collect repro steps and timeline for the PM/ops postmortem. :white_check_mark:
